insight: Offers unlimited recording and transcription free forever, monetizing team analytics and CRM sync where rivals cap free minutes.
name: Fathom
tagline: Free AI notetaker for Zoom, Meet, and Teams calls.
description: Records, transcribes, and summarizes video meetings with AI summaries, action items, and shareable clips. Free for unlimited individual recording; paid Team tiers add advanced AI, analytics, and CRM sync.

modelSupport.notes: Summaries come from Fathom's managed model pipeline; not user-selectable.

changelog.summary: Recategorized from voice to the new meeting category for notetakers/transcription.

edge: Unlimited recording and transcription free forever; monetizes team analytics and CRM sync where rivals cap free minutes.
cons: Best AI features gated to paid Team tiers
Bot must join the call to record
Less deep cross-meeting search than rivals
